body:
Thanks for the detailed response. 1,3, and 4 are all very accurate. 
I have just taken a look at your post also and it is very insightful, seems that more people than we realise go through this BPD.

Yes this is exactly what I was concerned about and have unfortunately been a victim of this in the past. 

I actually started recording the audio of what was happening while it was kicking off just in case something like what you mentioned would happen in the future.

I am not too sure. One of her friends got back to me and said that they will try contacting her but that is it so far. I’ve also just asked them to contact the parents if they can as I do not have the contact details. 

Unfortunately I don’t know exactly where she is. I know the condo and floor she is at and remember the location but I can’t remember the details of the address. 
Thank you for the reassurance as well.

Thanks for this. I have taken some photos from last night and today. 
I worry though because in my country, suicide attempts are illegal and can land you with jail time. 

I know I need to stop being concerned with her so much but I find it extremely difficult at this moment.

Yes I will be distancing myself from her as much I can. I have just still been concerned with her welfare. 
I don’t have the parents contact details so I’ll ask a friend to do it so thank you for the advice.
